camel_example: aliyun iot BatchBindDeviceToEdgeInstanceWithDriver --region cn-hangzhou --DriverId 021d154d2a2f4dd7a489773d9e040000 --IotIds.1 BXPV9Ks3bxwM9fD00000000101 --InstanceId F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000
description_en: Assigns devices to an edge instance in batches and configures drivers for the devices
description_zh: 批量将设备分配到边缘实例中，并为设备设置驱动
name: BatchBindDeviceToEdgeInstanceWithDriver

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You do not need to specify this parameter for public instances, but you must specify it for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), move the pointer over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the driver. On the Drivers page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), move the pointer over the name of the target driver to obtain the ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
驱动ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的驱动管理页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155776.html接口获取
parameters.name: driver_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of device IDs.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query all devices under the current account and obtain the device IotId.

You can bind a maximum of 20 devices in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID列表。
可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html查询当前账号下所有设备信息，获取设备IotId。

单次调用最多可绑定20个设备
parameters.name: iot_ids

Code.description_en: The return code of the operation. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates that the call was successful. A value of false indicates that the call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
